findings.reason: the fix as scoped breaks review-to-run resolution and review session continuation, so §3 must either change the id scheme so the source stays recoverable or add `dispatch_sessions.py`/`recovery_review_delivery.py` (with a parser update) to its write paths.
findings.text: §3 declares the later-round node id as `<prefix><source>-<head[:12]>` with `prefix` = `review-of-`, but two live readers recover the reviewed run by stripping exactly that prefix: `_task_identity` at `reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:436` and `_resolved_reviewed_run_id` at `reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:78`; with the head appended, `review-of-r-<stamp>-<head12>` yields a corrupted source that `_reviewed_run_id` (dispatch_sessions.py:397) falls back to returning verbatim, so a re-review no longer resolves to its reviewed run's task and `_resolved_reviewed_run_id` (used by promotion_checks.py:2027 and recovery_review_dispatch.py:177) returns a run id that names no run — while §3's declared write paths (`recovery_review_dispatch.py`, `repair.py`, the new test) and its statement that `recovery_review_subject.py` id sites are "outside this section" exclude both affected modules

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `dispatch_review_for_run`/`review_head_move`/`carry_review_forward` exist in `reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py`, `repair_node_id` in `reckon/crew/repair.py` composes `repair-of-<source>-<head[:12]>`, merge `7c923144a` resolves and its diff lands the test-only-light tier in `reckon/review_tiers.py`, and `/reckon/plans/the-review-loop-runs-without-hand-steps` and `/reckon/evidence/archive/a-moved-head-is-reviewed-landed.html#s2-why-the-reflex-launched-nothing` both resolve (extensionless href reads as `.html`).
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §3's done-when names four measurable watch-path cases and a declared negative control ("with the reused round id restored, the runtime-source resume case fails"), so its gate can show the guard fires.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the negative control is logged under the run directory and the gate list is built from the head tree, both durable paths, not a node-local temp dir.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the test is now `tests/test_a_resumed_head_is_reviewed.py`, a mechanism name distinct from the plan slug `a-moved-head-is-reviewed`, and no plan label, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the root cause is corroborated by §2's cited evidence, but the mechanism §3 chooses to fix it (embedding the head in the review node id) corrupts two existing consumers of that id, and neither lives in §3's declared write paths.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3 carries one deliverable, giving a re-review round an identity distinct from the round before, and its four cases all measure that one mechanism.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan's `informs` points at `a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk`, whose landed §5 carries a data-only move forward, which §3 relies on; §3's own ordering ("This section runs after §2") is satisfied because §2 is `done`, so no missing or misdirected relationship.
